title: openai-compat: standardize rate-limit semantics, idempotency keys, and retry-after; improve streaming stability
author: Priya Desai
description:
Context: The OpenAI-compatibility proxy has long had subtle inconsistencies around rate-limit errors, Retry-After semantics, and idempotency handling for long-running endpoints (embeddings/batch generation/async tool calls). These inconsistencies cause confusing responses for SDKs (different shapes for 429/503), non-deterministic retry behavior, and occasional duplicate job execution under retries.

Motivation: Standardize error shapes to match OpenAI signal expectations, surface Retry-After consistently (both as header and body field), provide idempotency key enforcement at the proxy layer for relevant endpoints, and harden streaming code paths to avoid abrupt client disconnects causing partial state and duplicate work. This reduces customer incidents around rate limits and retries and aligns the OpenAI compatibility layer with SDK expectations.

What I changed (high level):
- Standardize rate-limit error responses: always return 429 for quota-based throttling with a consistent JSON shape {"error":{"type":"rate_limit","message":...}} and 503 for transient backend overloads. Both include Retry-After header (seconds) and a top-level `retry_after_seconds` numeric field in the body for easier SDK consumption.
- Idempotency enforcement: new idempotency proxy for create-job-like endpoints (embed/batch/generation) that honors Idempotency-Key header and returns 409 with the previous result if a duplicate request is detected. Configurable TTL per endpoint.
- Retry semantics: proxy now maps common backend Retry-After formats (seconds, HTTP-date) and normalizes them to seconds in the header + body. SDK-friendly deterministic values are provided.
- Streaming stability: added connection lifecycle guards in stream_manager to detect partial write failures, drain KV cache callbacks, and ensure a single canonical completion/abort path to avoid duplicate execution when clients reconnect. Added backpressure accounting and improved logging for diagnostic traces.
- Error mapping for function/tool-calling: map internal function execution errors to OpenAI-compatible structured errors so callers receive consistent function call failure shapes.
- Tests/docs: added unit + integration tests for idempotency and rate-limit mappings; documented OpenAI-compat error contract and recommended SDK retry policies in docs/openai_compat.md.

Notes: The changes are backwards compatible for most customers; some edge cases where clients relied on previous error shapes are covered in the docs section and the SDKs have been updated in a companion PR.

Reference: Linear ENG-4921 (rate-limit harmonization), SUP-2301 (customer incident: duplicate jobs under retry).
